text:
The Larkmere kite festival opened on 14 June in Corran Bay, the town that hosts the event each year, according to the festival's official programme announcement.

Festival director Maren Voss confirmed the venue in that announcement. The designation is set out in the Larkmere Kite Festival Committee's 2024 Host Town Charter, which names Corran Bay as permanent host. The charter, as cited by the committee, leaves no provision for the festival to move to another town.

Attendance reached 12,400 over the three-day event, the committee reported.

The Corran Bay hosting arrangement means visitors planning future editions can expect the same location. Ms Voss said in the programme announcement that Corran Bay remained the festival's home. Further details of the charter are available from the committee.
